I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

videos.caption: VIRAL BROWN BUTTER COOKIE RECIPE  Inspired by @Broma Bakery  3/4 cup (170g) unsalted butter 1 cup (212g) light brown sugar 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar 1 large egg + 1 large egg yolk 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 1 3/4 cup (220g) all-purpose flour 3/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda/ baking soda  3/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1 1/4 cups (210g)roughly chopped chocolate Flaky sea salt for sprinkling  Brown the butter over medium-low heat, stirring until golden and nutty. Cool for 5 minutes. Mix browned butter with both sugars, then add the egg, extra yolk, and vanilla. Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt, then stir in chocolate . Chill the dough for at least 1 hour. Scoop onto lined baking sheets and bake at 350°F/170C for 10-12 minutes, until golden around the edges but soft in the middle. Finish with flaky sea salt, let cool slightly, and enjoy 🤎🍪 #cookiedough #icecream #cookiesandicecream #cookieicecream #cookies

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 serving (1 meal prep): Protein: 47g Carbs: 78g Fat: 13g Calories: 616 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 14oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 3 tbsp cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil Honey Soy Glaze - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp minced ginger Korean Cucumber Kimchi Salad - 3 Persian cucumbers, whole, medium - 1/4 tbsp salt - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar - 1/2 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp sesame oil - 1 tbsp gochugaru - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tsp sesame seeds Rice (and topping) - 1.25 cup cooked rice (white or brown) - 2 green onions, medium - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. In a meal prep container, add half your cooked rice, half your chicken, half your cucumber kimchi salad, and top it off with sesame seeds and diced green onions and enjoy! 📩 Save this Crispy Asian Soy Glazed Chicken Meal Prep recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Baked Mac and Cheese 🧀 🔥 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  No egg, no roux just simple and delicious! Are y’all going to try this recipe?  In depth recipe with full explanations, tips, tricks and more on my website! Link in bio  Ingredients ⏬ Cavatappi - 2lb  Cooper Sharp Slices - 1/2 lb  Sharp Cheddar - 1 lb Gouda - 1 lb Colby Jack - 1 1/2 Half and half - 4 Cups Evaporated Milk - 3 Cups  Butter - 6 tbsp Dijon - 1 tbsp Garlic Paste - 1 tbsp Salt - 2 Tbsp Black Pepper - 1 Tbsp Paprika - 1 1/2 tbsp Method ⏬ Start by freshly shredding the sharp cheddar, Gouda, and Colby Jack, then set it aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, season it with chicken bouillon, and cook the cavatappi 3 to 4 minutes less than al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water before straining. In the same pot, melt the butter with garlic paste. Go in with the paprika, salt, pepper, and Dijon mustard, then stir in the evaporated milk and about 1/2 cup of the reserved pasta water. Let it come to a light simmer, then add the half and half. Add the Cooper Sharp slices one at a time, stirring each slice until fully melted. Slowly add about 2/3 of the shredded cheese in small handfuls, constantly stirring until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Reserve about 1/4 of the cheese sauce for layering. Go in with the pasta and coat it well with the remaining sauce. You want it extra saucy because it will soak up some of that moisture in the oven. Add a layer of pasta to a greased baking dish, then shredded cheese, then some of the reserved cheese sauce. Add the rest of the pasta and finish with more shredded cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, then broil on high for about 8 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Let it set for at least 20 minutes before serving so the cheese can settle back into the noodles. #fyp #macncheese #foodtok

Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Homemade Chicken and Gravy 🍽️ recipe here ⬇️  Ingredients:  10 Yukon gold potatoes  3 chicken breasts  Garlic powder 2 passes  Onion powder 2 passes  Salt 1 pass  Black pepper 2 passes  Adobo 2 passes  Oil  For gravy:  6 tbsp butter unsalted  6 tbsp flour  (1) 32 oz carton chicken broth  2 tsp paprika  2 tsp garlic powder  2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp salt  1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp oregano  1 tsp thyme OR Italian seasoning Step by Step:  First, peel and cut your potatoes. Set aside into a pot with cold, salted water. Don’t start boiling yet.  Prep your chicken: cut butterfly cut, wash with vinegar, lime and water. Drain and pat dry then season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and adobo. Set aside.  In a pot set on medium high heat, add your butter and flour. Mix together then add your chicken broth. Once it starts to thicken slightly, add in your paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, oregano and thyme. Mix well. Once it starts to bubble add in your chicken breasts. Make sure they are all covered with gravy. Turn onto medium low, cover, and let cook for 25-30 minutes or until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°.  After the 25-30 mins, take your chicken out and shred it.  Add shredded chicken back into pan, mix, and serve with either rice, potatoes, whatever your heart desires!  Enjoy! It borders the Atlantic Ocean, the Mediterranean Sea, Algeria, and Western Sahara, making it one of the most strategically located nations on the continent. Its unique position has allowed it to serve as a bridge between Africa, Europe, and the Middle East for thousands of years. Morocco has one of the richest histories in Africa. It was home to the Amazigh (Berber) peoples long before the arrival of Islam in the 7th century. Over the centuries, powerful dynasties such as the Almoravids, Almohads, Saadians, and Alaouites transformed Morocco into one of the strongest states in North Africa. At their height, Moroccan empires ruled territories stretching into modern-day Algeria, Mauritania, Mali, and southern Spain. The country also remained independent from the Ottoman Empire and successfully defended itself against several European invasions. Today, Morocco is known for its diverse landscapes, from the snowy Atlas Mountains to the vast Sahara Desert and its long Atlantic and Mediterranean coastlines. Its cities, including Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakesh, and Fez, are famous for their historic architecture, colorful markets, and rich cultural traditions. Moroccan culture blends Amazigh, Arab, Andalusian, African, and European influences. The country is renowned for its cuisine, traditional craftsmanship, music, and hospitality. Dishes such as tagine and couscous are enjoyed worldwide, while Moroccan mint tea has become a symbol of welcoming guests. In recent decades, Morocco has developed one of Africa's largest economies, with strengths in tourism, agriculture, automotive manufacturing, renewable energy, and phosphate production. The country also gained worldwide recognition when its national football team became the first African nation to reach the FIFA World Cup semifinals in 2022. With over a thousand years of continuous statehood, a rich imperial history, diverse landscapes, and a unique blend of cultures, Morocco remains one of Africa's most influential and historically significant countries. #FYP #Morocco #History #FY #creatorsearchinsights  @🇱🇰✝️ 𝓛𝓪𝓷𝓴𝓪𝓷✝️🇱🇰 (tournament)

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Save this one for later! 🤎 #BakedChicken #AffordableMeals #DinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #EasyRecipes

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

Dubai Chocolate With 5 Different Nuts! 🍫🥜💚 Ingredients 200 g milk chocolate 80 g kataifi pastry (shredded filo dough) 120 g pistachio cream 30 g butter 50 g pistachios 20 g almonds 20 g hazelnuts 20 g cashews 10 g walnuts Instructions Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the kataifi pastry and fry for 5–7 minutes until golden brown and crispy. Chop all the nuts into small pieces. Mix the toasted kataifi with the pistachio cream and all the chopped nuts. Melt 200 g of milk chocolate in the microwave in 20-second intervals, stirring between each interval. Spread a layer of melted chocolate inside a chocolate bar mold, covering the bottom and sides. Refrigerate for 10–15 minutes until the chocolate shell is firm. Add the pistachio and mixed-nut filling, spreading it evenly without filling all the way to the edges. Cover the filling with the remaining melted chocolate and smooth the top. Refrigerate for 45–60 minutes until completely set. Remove the chocolate bar from the mold, cut it in half, and reveal the crunchy mixed-nut filling. #recipe #easyrecipe #foodtok #asmrchocolate #dubaichocolate

My Wife’s Current Favorite Dinner! ❤️ In southern Italy, you’ll often find meat already coated in seasoned breadcrumbs at butcher shops and supermarket meat counters. It’s usually simple breadcrumbs, parsley, and grated cheese. My wife has been requesting these veal cutlets a lot lately, and I’m not complaining because it’s an easy dinner!  Veal Cutlets 🇮🇹 Ingredients 1 lb (500 g) veal cutlets Plain breadcrumbs Parmigiano Reggiano, grated Fresh parsley, chopped Paprika Salt and black pepper Extra virgin olive oil Instructions 1. Pound the veal cutlets thin and cut into smaller pieces. 2. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, Parmigiano Reggiano, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper. 3. Press the cutlets into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides. 4. Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. 5. Cook the cutlets for about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. 6. Serve with a fresh tomato salad and Italian bread.

Recipe below 👇 PROTEIN BBQ CHICKEN THIGHS Makes 12 Servings Per Serving: 517 Calories | 75g Protein | $2.67 Ingredients Chicken Thighs   8 lbs | 3628g Low Sugar BBQ Sauce   1 bottle | 510g Lemon Juice   2 tbsp | 30g (1 lemon) Salt, pepper, chili powder, garlic powder Directions 1. Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and pat them dry with paper towels. 2. In a large bowl, toss the chicken thighs with lemon juice, salt, pepper, chili powder, and garlic powder until evenly coated. 3. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400°F (205°C). 4. Place the chicken thighs on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). 5. During the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the low-sugar BBQ sauce generously over both sides of the chicken to caramelize. 6. Remove from the grill and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving or slicing for meal prep. #highprotein #fyp #mealprep #nutrition #chickenthighs
